declared_rule.S1_fixed_EST_rejection: Daylight-season weekday headers with wall in [16:30,17:30): n>=30 and same-day FILING-DATE share >=0.99.
declared_rule.S2_UTC_rejection: Weekday headers with wall in [17:35,21:30): n>=20 and later FILING-DATE share >=0.95. If n<20, S3 decides: >=20 walls in [06:00,10:00) and operating-window violations <=0.1%.
declared_rule.integrity: Weekday walls <=17:30 whose FILING-DATE rolled forward <=0.5%, and walls outside [06:00,22:00] <=0.1% of the evaluated population.
declared_rule.passed: S1 AND UTC rejection AND integrity.
declared_rule.population: Readable headers with one acceptance wall, one filing date and a unique Eastern conversion; Rule 13(a)(3)-(4) 22:00-cutoff forms excluded.

interpretation_if_passed: Header walls behave as the Rule 13(a)(2) Eastern civil clock (EST or EDT in effect). This rejects fixed-EST and UTC readings; it does not verify EDGAR's synchronization to UTC or correctness of any JSON timestamp.
data_boundary: Metadata headers only; no HTTP request in this phase.
